Interface MetricsRecorder

All Known Implementing Classes:
InMemoryMetricsRecorder, OtelMetricsRecorder
public interface MetricsRecorder
Sink for CockroachDB operational metrics.

The transaction methods are called by application code (directly or through CrdbMetrics.timeTransaction(Callable)); the retry and circuit methods are driven automatically by CrdbMetricsListener, which forwards the core observe event bus into this recorder.

All methods have empty defaults so an implementation overrides only the signals it cares about. Implementations must be thread-safe: events fire from arbitrary application threads.

      default void recordTransaction(Duration duration, int retries, boolean success)
      Record a completed transaction.
      Parameters:
      duration - wall-clock duration of the transaction (including retries)
      retries - number of retries used (0 if it committed on first try)
      success - whether the transaction ultimately committed
